title: Playlist Politics
blurb: Aux cord tyrants, shower singers and the person who knew the band before they were cool.

prompts: Most likely to take over the aux cord within thirty seconds of getting in the car
Most likely to sing at full volume in the shower with the door open
Most likely to know every word of the chorus and not a single word of the verses
Most likely to claim they "liked that band before they were famous"
Most likely to cry at a song that is not even sad
Most likely to make a playlist with a title that is far too long
Most likely to be late because they had to finish one more track
Most likely to dance in the supermarket when the right song comes on
Most likely to play air guitar so seriously that they hurt themselves
Most likely to own a record player and no records
Most likely to use a song's title in a conversation just to start singing it
Most likely to hum a tune all day and not know where it came from
Most likely to buy concert tickets for a band they've only heard once
Most likely to cry at the concert and blame the dust
Most likely to start a band in the garage and name it something regrettable
Most likely to get a song stuck in their head for a week
Most likely to sing the wrong lyrics with total conviction
Most likely to argue that an album is better in the original order
Most likely to turn every car trip into a full karaoke session
Most likely to mishear a lyric for a decade and be told in public
Most likely to film the whole concert on their phone instead of watching it
Most likely to use the word "banger" for something that is definitely not a banger
Most likely to create a playlist for every mood they've ever had
Most likely to say "this is my song" about every song in the pub
Most likely to sing harmony to every song whether it needs one or not
Most likely to learn a whole instrument for one song
Most likely to arrive early at a gig to be at the front and leave early to beat the traffic
Most likely to have a guilty-pleasure playlist they would never share
Most likely to remember what they were wearing the first time they heard a certain song
Most likely to sing on the train with headphones in and not realise
Most likely to nominate themselves as the DJ at every party
Most likely to be the person who still hasn't forgiven a band for changing their sound
Most likely to get dragged up to dance at a wedding and win the floor
Most likely to add a country song to the road trip playlist and start an argument
Most likely to have a favourite song that's older than they are
Most likely to yell "play something we know" at a live band
Most likely to rank every album by one artist without being asked
Most likely to discover a new favourite band at a festival's smallest stage
Most likely to make a mixtape for someone as a grand romantic gesture
Most likely to play one song on repeat for a whole week
Most likely to be offended when a streaming app recommends the same song again
Most likely to put on a "chill" playlist that is actually a heavy metal compilation
